name: Up the River - Climb VR
summary:
Up the River is a thrilling VR adventure that challenges your balance, strength, and skill as you paddle against nature itself. Armed with only an oar, you must climb, push, and row your way upstream through powerful currents and treacherous obstacles.

Each stretch of the river brings new challenges — from rocky cliffs and tumbling logs to rushing waterfalls and tight canyons. Use realistic motion controls to paddle, pull, and maneuver with precision as you fight the current and find your path forward.
